en:
Events are the soul of a Phigros chart. All types of events make judge line appear/disappear, move, rotate and so on.

Currently, there are 10 kinds of events:

	Alpha: They control the appearance and disappearance of the judge line.
	Rotate: Literally, they control the rotation of the judge line.
	Speed: They control the falling speed of all the notes on the judge line.
	X and Y: They control the movement of the judge line.

	Color: They control the color of the judge line.
	Incline: Useless currently.
	Text: They will make the judge line disappear and replace it with a text you input. (This event isn't available in the current version)
	ScaleX and ScaleY: They control the scale of the judge line.

Event layers can make you put more than one event each event type at the same time. You can put normal events(The first 5 types of events above) in the first 4 event layers and extra events(The last 5 types of events above) in the last event layer.Obviously, that means the extra events DONOT support multiple event layers.

Notice: Every type of event in each event layer need a base event(like events at the bottom in the first event layer)! When you don't need a type of events in an event layer any more, you need to delete all events above the base event first, then you can delete the base event.
zh:
事件是一张Phigros谱面的灵魂。各种类型的事件让判定线显现/消失，移动，旋转，等等。

目前共有10种类型的事件：

	Alpha（透明度事件）：控制判定线的显现和消失。
	Rotate（旋转事件）：顾名思义，就是控制判定线的旋转。
	Speed（速度事件）：控制这根判定线上的音符下落速度。
	X（X轴移动事件）和Y（Y轴移动事件）：控制判定线的移动。

	Color（颜色事件）: 控制判定线的颜色。
	Incline：目前没用。
	Text（文字事件）：使判定线消失，并以你输入的文字代替。（当前版本尚未实现该事件）
	ScaleX（X轴缩放事件）和ScaleY（Y轴缩放事件）：控制判定线的缩放。

事件层可以让你在同一时间内放置多个同种类型的事件。你可以在前4个事件层内放置普通事件（上述的前5个事件类型），在最后一个事件层内放置EX事件（上述的后5个事件类型）。显然，这意味着EX事件不支持多事件层。

注意：每个事件层中每种类型的事件都需要一个垫底事件（就像第一事件层中最底部的事件一样）！当你不再需要某个事件层中某类型的事件时，你需要先删除垫底事件之上的所有事件，然后你才可以删除垫底事件。

en:
Here is the tutorial of how to set the value of all types of events:

	Alpha: From 0(transparent) to 1(opaque) and any negative value(hide the line and all notes on it)
	Rotate: For example, 180 means the line turns 180 degrees
	Speed: For example, 1 means the notes will move 1 screen height per second
	X: From -1(left of the screen) to 1(right of the screen)
	Y: From -1(top of the screen) to 1(bottom of the screen)

	Color: Input the hex code of the color
	Incline: Useless currently
	Text: Input the text you want to display
	ScaleX and ScaleY: Input the scale factor of the texture you want
zh:
以下是如何设置各种类型事件的值的教程：

	Alpha（透明度事件）：从0（透明）到1（不透明）以及任意负值（隐藏判定线及其上全部音符）
	Rotate（旋转事件）：例如，180意味着判定线旋转180度
	Speed（速度事件）：例如，1意味着音符会在每秒内移动1个屏幕高
	X（横向移动事件）：从-1（屏幕左侧）到1（屏幕右侧）
	Y（纵向移动事件）：从-1（屏幕上方）到1（屏幕下方）

	Color（颜色事件）：输入颜色的十六进制码
	Incline：目前没用
	Text（文字事件）：输入你想要显示的文字
	ScaleX（X轴缩放事件）和ScaleY（Y轴缩放事件）：输入你想要的纹理缩放比例

en: If you want to bind some notes on a judge line, you should use this method called "Line binding". It's core is to put a zero value speed event to make the notes stick to the judge line, then you can control the notes by controling the judge line. When you want to recycle the note, you need to make sure the move speed of the judge line is the same with other normal notes'.\nOf course, if you don't want to calculate event values, you can use fake notes to make them no need to hit. Just select a note and turn on the fake note switch, then click apply button.
zh: 如果你想在一条判定线上绑定一些音符，你需要使用这种叫做“绑线”的方法。它的核心是放置一个零值速度事件让音符黏在判定线上，然后你就可以通过控制判定线来控制音符。当你想要回收音符时，你需要确保判定线的移动速度和其他正常音符的移动速度一致。当然，如果你不想计算事件值，你可以使用假音符让它们无需击打。你只需要选择一个音符然后打开假音符开关，然后点击应用按钮。
